column3: This sheet shows the CO2 EOR Evaluation System FYBE CO2 storage cost associated with oil production and performance outputs for every conventional oilfield that has potential for future CO2 EOR development.  The cost data is used to saline storage costs in the 'Transport Dist Calculator' sheet. This sheet also calculates if these oilfields are 'shovel-ready', i.e., likely to be able to deploy CO2 EOR in the near-term based on the ratio of current to original oil in place - oil fields are likely to continue primary or secondary/waterflood oil production if the current to original oil in place ratio is high.
